newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Average cost of Brazil public debt is 18.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Average cost of Brazil public debt is 18.5 pct.

text.p: The average implicit interest rate Brazil's public sector paid on its huge debt stockpile in January was 1.43 percent a month or 18.5 percent a year, the Central Bank said.
In a statement, the bank said the average interest paid on the net internal debt of 240.78 billion reais was 1.54 percent a month or 20.2 percent in annualized terms.
The implicit interest rate on external debt averaged a much lower 0.55 percent a month or 6.8 percent a year. The net external debt stockpile in January was 32.83 billion reais.

The Central Bank showed in its statement that the federal government and Central Bank enjoyed significant cost advantages over the states and municipalities in terms of interest paid on their debts, but state-owned firms faced the lowest costs.
The average interest on federal government and central bank debt was 1.46 percent a month in January, or 19.0 percent a year.
States and municipalities paid an average 1.7 percent a month or 22.4 percent a year and state firms 1.4 percent a month or 18.1 percent annually.
